note: Equal-weight, chain-linked sub-sector indices from data/scans/. Built by tools/build_indices.py; constituents in data/indices/indices.json.

indices.name: AI Data Centre
indices.note: The build-out chain for AI compute in India: optical fibre, power systems, servers, GPU cloud, networking, DC real estate and EPC.

indices.name: Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear
indices.note: Fibre, optical cable and telecom equipment. The power-cable names that used to sit here moved to Wires & Cables (12 Oct 2026).

indices.name: Semiconductors & Chip Design
indices.note: Chip design, OSAT and power semiconductors in India: small and early, which is why the moves are large.

indices.name: EMS & Electronics
indices.note: Contract electronics manufacturers: consumer, industrial, automotive and aerospace boards and box builds.

indices.name: CNC Machines
indices.note: Machine tools and CNC systems.

indices.name: Transformers & Reactors
indices.note: Transformer and reactor makers on their own, as the owner asked: the grid-equipment names with the longest order books.

indices.name: Wires & Cables
indices.note: Wire, cable and conductor makers, separated from transformers and from telecom fibre.

indices.name: Power T&D Equipment & EPC
indices.note: Grid equipment majors and the transmission-line EPC names; transformers and cables now have their own trackers.

indices.name: Pipes
indices.note: Line pipes, stainless and structural tubes: the export and pipeline capex cycle.

indices.name: Railways
indices.note: Rail EPC, wagons, financing and signalling: one budget line moves all of them.

indices.name: Defence
indices.note: Platforms, electronics, missiles, drones and explosives: the order-driven defence names, separated from aerospace components.

indices.name: Aerospace Components & Machining
indices.note: Precision parts, castings and engineering for aero engines and airframes (Unimech, Sigma, Azad, Aequs...): a global-supply-chain read rather than an Indian defence-budget read.

indices.name: Shipbuilding & Marine
indices.note: Shipyards, ship owners, marine services and marine electricals.

indices.name: CDMO
indices.note: Contract development and manufacturing: the outsourcing leaders and the smaller API/intermediate CDMOs riding the same demand.

indices.name: Pharma Mid & Small
indices.note: Mid and small-cap pharma with a live trigger — IOL and SMS on the ibuprofen shortage — plus the strongest-RS names in the group.

indices.name: API & Bulk Drugs
indices.note: Active-ingredient makers (ibuprofen, paracetamol, metformin...): the Middle East ibuprofen shortage of Oct 2026 is the kind of move this tracker is for.

indices.name: Hospitals
indices.note: Hospital chains, large and regional.

indices.name: Dyes & Pigments (H-acid, K-acid)
indices.note: Dye intermediates and pigments: the H-acid and K-acid price cycle (Shree Pushkar, Bodal, Kiri, Bhageria) shows up here first. Was "Specialty Chem - Dyes" until 12 Oct 2026.

indices.name: Specialty Chemicals
indices.note: Fluorochemicals, amines, surfactants, aroma and performance chemicals: the specialty names proper, without dyes or agrochemicals.

indices.name: Battery Materials & Cells
indices.note: Electrolytes and salts (Neogen, Tatva Chintan), anode and electrode carbon (Himadri, HEG, Graphite), cell makers (Exide, HBL).

indices.name: Agrochemicals
indices.note: Crop-protection makers and formulators; monsoon, channel inventory and China pricing drive them.

indices.name: Fertilisers
indices.note: Urea, phosphatics and complex fertilisers: subsidy and gas-price driven.

indices.name: Solar Modules & EPC
indices.note: Module and cell makers, solar glass, EPC and the listed renewable developers.

indices.name: Wind
indices.note: Turbine makers and wind O&M: four names, so one of them moves the index.

indices.name: Power Generators, Grid & Financiers
indices.note: Generators, the transmission utility and the power lenders: the demand side of the electricity story.

indices.name: PSU Banks
indices.note: All twelve public-sector banks, equal weight, so the small ones count as much as SBI.

indices.name: Capital Markets
indices.note: Exchanges, depositories, registrars, brokers, AMCs and distributors: the names that earn from market activity itself.

members.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries

indices.name: Jewellery & Gold Retail
indices.note: Gold and diamond jewellers: gold price, festival demand and store expansion.

indices.name: Hotels
indices.note: Hotel owners and operators: room rates and occupancy.

indices.name: Textiles & Apparel Exporters
indices.note: Garment and home-textile exporters and spinners: US tariffs and cotton prices.

indices.name: Sugar & Ethanol
indices.note: Sugar mills with ethanol capacity: policy-driven (ethanol price, export quota).

indices.name: Real Estate
indices.note: Listed developers and the one mall owner: pre-sales, launches and rates.
